ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: in the figure, the left foot of the mountain profile is marked “N”, indicating the northern slope; the right foot is marked “S”, indicating the southern slope. The stem states that the thick line is the snow line, and in the figure the thick line on the left northern slope is lower than that on the right southern slope. Then reason: because the windward slope has more precipitation and snow accumulation and glaciers develop more easily, the snow line is usually lower; the leeward slope is drier and the snow line is higher. Therefore, the side with the lower snow line, namely the northern slope, is the windward slope.
